newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble appoints Leo Burnett.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble appoints Leo Burnett.

text.p: Procter & Gamble said on Tuesday it assigned the independent advertising agency Leo Burnett to market its Tampax tampons product, pending completion of P&G's acquisition of Tambrands Inc.
In reporting the appointment, P&G cited the agency's past work marketing products targeted for women, including the Femstat 3 treatments for vaginal yeast infections and Secret antiperspirant.
P&G said True North Communications Inc unit Foote Cone & Belding, which currently handles Tampax, worked for one of its global competitors, presenting a conflict.
In a separate assignment, P&G said D'Arcy Masius Benton & Bowles would take over Pampers in Latin America.
D'Arcy Masius is a unit of MacManus Group, a privately held holding company.
